'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[Battle of Marib]]
***Sixty [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] militants and 18 pro-[[government of Yemen|government]] [[Republic of Yemen Armed Forces|soldiers]] are killed during a 48-hour battle over the control of [[Marib]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1924961/middle-east (Arab News)]
*Aftermath of the [[Fall of Kabul (2021)|Fall of Kabul]]
**Former [[President of Afghanistan|president]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] apologizes to the Afghan people and reiterates that he left the country in order to avoid "bloody street fighting" for control of [[Kabul]] and also vehemently denies stealing from the country's treasury. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/8/ashraf-ghani-apologises-afghans-says-fled-ensure-peace (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War crimes in the Tigray War]]
**Local officials in the [[Amhara Region]] report that [[Tigray Defense Forces|rebellious forces]] from the [[Tigray Region]] killed 120 civilians in a single village in two days. Tigrayan forces later issue a statement rejecting what they call a "fabricated allegation" and deny any involvement in the killing of civilians. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tigray-forces-killed-120-civilians-amhara-village-ethiopia-officials-2021-09-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tangerang prison fire]]
**A fire at a prison in [[Tangerang]], [[Banten]], [[Indonesia]], kills 44 inmates and injures at least 80 others. [https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/1783120.html (AFP via RTL)]
*Seven people are killed and at least 15 are injured by a [[gas explosion]] in an apartment in [[Noginsk]], [[Moscow Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80hW8Dl5H18 (Ruptly)] [https://tass.com/emergencies/1335597 (TASS)]
*A fire at a [[field hospital]] catering to [[COVID-19 pandemic in North Macedonia|COVID-19]] patients in [[Tetovo]], [[North Macedonia]], kills at least 14 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58496405 (BBC News)]
*[[President of Kenya]] [[Uhuru Kenyatta]] declares the state of disaster due to the strong [[drought]] affecting the country. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/kenyan-leader-declares-drought-national-disaster/2359416 (Anadolu Agency)]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the Republic of Ireland]]
***The [[Republic of Ireland|Irish]] [[Department of Health (Ireland)|Department of Health]] announces that people aged 80 or older and residents of [[nursing home]]s aged 65 and older will receive a booster [[MRNA]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] regardless of which vaccine they first received. The booster rollout will begin at the end of September or the start of October. [https://m.independent.ie/irish-news/booster-doses-confirmed-for-over-80s-and-for-those-over-65-in-nursing-homes-40831204.html (Independent.ie)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[New Zealand]] moves to Alert Level 2 outside [[Auckland]] with mandatory scanning in bars, restaurants, churches, and close-contact businesses, [[social distancing]] increasing to {{convert|2|m}} in public places, and [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask]]s being mandatory in indoor public places. [https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/new-zealand/majority-new-zealand-wakes-up-delta-level-2 (TVNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[Singapore]] begins to implement Vaccinated Travel Lane first flight from [[Germany]] containing 100 passengers arrived at [[Changi Airport]]. The travellers are required to take [[Polymerase chain reaction|PCR]] test and self-isolate until they have received a negative result for their on-arrival test.  [https://www.todayonline.com/singapore/vaccinated-travel-lane-first-flight-100-passengers-germany-lands-changi-airport (''Today'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The United States has had over 40 million diagnosed cases of COVID-19 with four million of those cases occurring in the last four weeks. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/07/health/us-coronavirus-tuesday/index.html (CNN)]  
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii]]
****The [[ʻAlohilani Resort Waikiki Beach|Alohilani Resort]] in [[Honolulu]] will require vaccinations for workers, becoming the first resort hotel in [[Hawaii]] to do so. The mandate will take effect on October 15. [https://www.kitv.com/story/44694479/alohilani-resort-waikiki-announces-mandatory-vaccination-requirements (KITV)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nevada]]
****[[Nevada]] [[Governor of Nevada|Governor]] [[Steve Sisolak]] announces that all 17 counties in the state will be subjected to a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]]. [https://lasvegassun.com/news/2021/sep/08/all-nevada-counties-will-be-subject-to-indoor-mask/ (''Las Vegas Sun'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Guinean coup d'état]]
**The [[Economic Community of West African States]] suspends [[Guinea]]'s membership in the bloc until further notice, in response to the [[coup d'état]] in the country. [https://guardian.ng/news/ecowas-suspends-guinea-announces-mediation-mission/ (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**Police in [[Hong Kong]] arrest four members of the [[Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China]], the pro-[[democracy]] organization in charge of the [[Tiananmen Square protests]] anniversary vigils as police say that the group refused to submit information on national security grounds. Chief Executive [[Carrie Lam]] condemns the group and welcomes the arrests. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/09/07/asia/hong-kong-alliance-arrest-nsl-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[November 2015 Paris attacks]]
**The trial against those accused of the Paris attacks in November 2015 begins, being described as the biggest trial in the history of modern France. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58486391 (BBC News)]
*A court in [[Milan]], [[Italy]], orders a [[medical examination]] of former [[Prime Minister of Italy|prime minister]] [[Silvio Berlusconi]] as his trial on alleged [[bribery]] continues to be delayed due to his hospital visits since it began in 2017. Berlusconi's lawyers welcome the decision of the court. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/italian-court-seeks-opinion-berlusconis-health-due-trial-delays-2021-09-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Winter Olympics]], [[North Korea at the Olympics]]
**The [[International Olympic Committee]] announces that they have suspended [[North Korea]] from participating in the upcoming [[Winter Olympics]] in [[Beijing]] after the country failed to send a delegation to the [[2020 Summer Olympics|Summer Olympics]] in [[Tokyo]]. The suspension will last until the end of 2022. [https://apnews.com/575b65ffa051a72beec5a47d10a0e4ca (AP)]
